## Design Tables

The design tables for each process step show a concise summary of the parametric desgin of the unit. 
This includes the user sepcificed parameters as well as derived values from the specifications like calculation of flow velocity based of unit dimensions and flowrate

When a parameter is derivied from a number of different values it will show with a little plus sign on the left hand. Opening this dropdowm by click the plus sign will show the corresponding parameters that are used in the calculation.


On top of the design tables page a list icon that changes the layout to a simplified list. 
There each parameter and its calculation formula are detailed with color coded paramternames to crossreference the different values used in the formula. 
This overview also highlight which global parameters are used. For example the emission from electiricy consumption parameter in the sustainability calculation of the unit.
